name: comp_ensemble_2026-09-25
strategy: Only names at least two independent lenses would pick: revision flow (net raises from many firms), dated catalysts inside Oct 12-Nov 13, power-grid inflection flags, and Asia supply-chain momentum. The book is semis/memory plus AI power hardware plus dated FDA and defense prints, so relative P&L comes from real Q3 numbers and PDUFA decisions rather than theme drift. I would be wrong if a single macro shock (hyperscaler capex digestion, Taiwan tension, or a broad CRL cluster) hits the correlated semis and biotech sleeves at once, or if the defense and gambling prints sell off on in-line results.
